items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: Another guy was Freddie Washington. He had a piano player named Freddie Washington.

ctx.x: Lloyd Glenn, another one, yeah. So Ory seemed to me to have... The only really what you'd call 100 percent regular was Tudie and Ram -- Tudie and Ram and Ory. The rest of it was like a nucleus. But they stayed with him the whole time, didn't they.
Another guy was Freddie Washington. He had a piano player named Freddie Washington.
